biggest_catch: Full Election Day is a 16-hour day (5:30am-9:30pm); split shifts are available but then earnings are proportionally less.
catches: Must be a registered voter in Essex County in either the Democratic or Republican party.
Must attend a three-hour paid training class annually (certification required).
Split shifts are available; figures here are for a full Election Day (5:30am-9:30pm).
Early Voting day pay is also $18.75/hr but Early Voting daily hours are not stated in this document, so they are not included in the numeric figures.

c1.evidence: Essex County Board of Elections official document (co.essex.ny.us).

c2.evidence: $18.75/hr for Early Voting and Election days; $60 for the annual 3-hour training class.

c3.evidence: No fee to apply or serve.

eligibility: Registered voter in Essex County, NY in either the Democratic or Republican party; able to read and write English; attend the paid 3-hour training class.
notes: Route framed around a full Election Day: 16 hrs x $18.75/hr = $300, plus $60 training. Early Voting day hours are unstated, so early-voting earnings ($18.75/hr) are excluded from numerics.
numeric_basis: payout from official terms ($18.75/hr x 16 hrs Election Day + $60 training); time: Election Day 5:30am-9:30pm (960 min) + 3-hr paid training (180 min)
payout_quote: Work from 5:30AM to 9:30PM on Primary Day (Split shifts are available). Work from 5:30AM to 9:30PM on Election Day (Split shifts are available). All Election Inspectors are required to: Attend a three hour (paid) training class annually. Yes, by your Board of Elections. You will be paid $60.00 for your attendance at your training class and $18.75/hr hour for Early Voting and Election days.
payout_value_note: Full Election Day 16 hrs x $18.75/hr = $300, plus $60 for the annual 3-hour paid training class = $360 total.

steps: Be a registered voter in Essex County, NY in either the Democratic or Republican party.
Attend the three-hour paid training class (required annually for certification).
Contact the Essex County Board of Elections (518-873-3474) to sign up.
Work a full Election Day, 5:30am to 9:30pm (or a split shift).
timing: Election Day/Primary Day; training annually before serving.
